# Text API

Edit Unicode text while preserving selection and IME composition.

This page is lookup reference for the exact public contract. Start from the usage examples when you are composing or styling the component.

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Standard editing keys</kbd> | Edit and select text with the host input conventions. |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | Commit focus movement without replacing native text behavior. |
